steps.name: Angry Company Representative
steps.text: What the freak is with that tree up in the air?

steps.name: Angry Company Representative
steps.text: There are only a few days until the exhibition! How many stands does that thing take up? Rhine Lab didn't apply for upper-level exhibition rights!

steps.name: Anxious Company Representative
steps.text: Rhine and the ATAO must be colluding! I saw Gordon Tannen on that tree that night!

steps.name: Anxious Company Representative
steps.text: Gustave, former ATAO Director, promised in a broadcast that he'd have an explanation the next morning. And what actually happened?

steps.name: Anxious Company Representative
steps.text: Not one word from the committee! I bet they're stalling for time!

steps.name: Staff
steps.text: Please remain patient.

steps.name: Staff
steps.text: The credibility of the Propeller Paradise administration and engineering departments is at stake here. We need to deal with this carefully and come up with a plan that can satisfy the hundreds of corporations that have an interest in the project.

steps.name: Angry Company Representative
steps.text: Who's asking you to deal with it carefully?

steps.name: Staff
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Angry Company Representative
steps.text: Who gives a crap? It's not like this is another Ring Lab.

steps.name: Angry Company Representative
steps.text: The engineering department's inspections have stopped, and the administration's vetting is over. Who cares if Propeller Paradise officials are doing their jobs or not?

steps.name: Staff
steps.text: But the hearing is a necessary part of the oversight process...

steps.name: Anxious Company Representative
steps.text: Investigations and trials, those are your problem. We just want to know the result of the hearing—

steps.name: Anxious Company Representative
steps.text: The Air Expo Columbia we expected to make a splash in Columbia and even all of Terra—is it gonna happen or not?

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police
steps.text: Out of the way.

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police
steps.text: I said, out of the way.

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police
steps.text: You really think that sitting here puts your illegal equipment out of our reach?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: It remains Rhine Lab property until the hearing is underway. Besides, what are you calling 'illegal equipment'?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Don't you recognize a floating botanical unit when you see it? The saplings floating around you are no different from the one behind us.

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police
steps.text: You insolent little... I need more men over here!

steps.name: Researcher
steps.text: Sky, we don't have the numbers. We can only hold out for so long, if they decide to use force.

steps.name: Researcher
steps.text: Besides, we don't know whether this tree-like device behind us is legal, or whether it's safe. After all, it's only been two years since Control Wright...

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: I'll ask you one question. As a scientist, are you willing to just hand over the product of Director Lunorey's sweat and blood?

steps.name: Researcher
steps.text: No, but...

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Then take action. Leave no regrets.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: If only we had more people. But Rhine only has so many people on Propeller Paradise...
Did you forget that we're Rhine Lab people too, Mr. Jagger?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: I didn't want to drag you into this.

steps.name: Tester B
steps.text: You're worried about the hearing? Hah, it's not like we haven't seen our share of trumped-up charges.

steps.name: Tester A
steps.text: Those guards wouldn't have gotten onto this platform if you called us sooner.

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police
steps.text: Bunch of slumslugs trying to play the hero?

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police
steps.text: Possession of illegal equipment, destruction of property, aiding and abetting... there's enough to keep all of you locked away for years!

steps.name: Tester B
steps.text: I'd already be locked away if Director Lunorey didn't take me in.

steps.name: Tester A
steps.text: You wanna touch the tree, you have to go through us!

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police
steps.text: Don't threaten me with a good time!
Rhine researchers and testers form a wall against the guards attempting to enter, while curious onlookers on the outside look up at the towering 'tree'.
A tall, dark figure walks past the rear of the crowd, footsteps clanking.
So... this is Rhine's 'tree'.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: It's an honor to see you here.
Oh, you flatter me, Mercia. I've been on an extended holiday and it's about time I got back in the saddle.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Are you here for the hearing?
Yes. The design of the Maylander Emergency Management Council badge is pretty nice. You should try one on.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Is my mission over?
Our mission has only just started.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: What are your orders?
No rush. These past few days have been quite eventful. Other than Nasti and Gordon Tannen, are there any other stories that I should hear?
Good.
See you at the ropeway station in five minutes. There's so much going on with Propeller Paradise that I'm sure I'll need a local guide.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: (Broken muttering)

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Sorry, I should have closed the window.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Company reps and testers are protesting on the streets. The longer the hearing takes, the more restless they get.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Are you feeling better?

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: (Weak breathing)

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: You're in poor shape.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: You've already seen Director Lunorey. Perhaps I should send you back to the Convallis—

steps.name: Væla
steps.text: No... no...

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Another no, just like last night.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Things will only get messier on Propeller Paradise in the coming days.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: It'll be even more difficult to leave.

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: We're in jail again! They didn't even bother to change our cell!

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: The time of the hearing keeps changing... you think they might be looking for more evidence and stack even more charges on us?

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: Look, if they ask, I'm telling the truth that you're the impostor!

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: Come on, say something, you're scaring me...

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: You know, nomadic prisons on the barrenlands could become tourist attractions. The only problem is that it's much easier to get in than out.

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: You're still thinking about tours at a time like this?

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: You've already lost one client, and now you're putting your other one in jail?

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: I'll find her. And there's no need for you to worry.

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: How do you figure?

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: No trial, no ID check, no notice to appear... you think the guards are just stalling for time to find a way to charge us?

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: I don't think so. I think it's a sign—

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: You and I are not the focus of this hearing.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Ferne and Oakley are in jail. Merry hasn't been seen since last night. All the phone lines at the registrar are busy. Everyone and their Originium slugs are looking for me and Nasti.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: It's time I put what I learned from the old man into practice. I'll have an answer for everything. I have nothing to fear!

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Looks like the old fox has lost his touch. No one's come to interrogate me yet.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Wait a second!

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Phew... alright, I still show up as the chief executive of Propeller Paradise on the terminal.

steps.name: Space Finbeast
steps.text: Beep—'Sky Conqueror' is currently under excessive stress. Please remember your health. We are on a long journey that leads beyond Terra.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Dammit, are they gonna start that hearing or not? Everything would be over and done with if I were in charge! That old coot just keeps tripping me up. It's been this way for seven years!
Why haven't you gotten one bit better in the past seven years?

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Gustave...

steps.name: Gustave
steps.text: How would YOU do it, if you were in charge?

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Uh...

steps.name: Gustave
steps.text: You thought you could pat yourself on the back for stopping the Rhine inspections, thinking you could continue to run your little hustle worry-free...

steps.name: Gustave
steps.text: What do you think ATAO was, a kindergarten? Is that how you ended up this naive?

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Everything would have gone smoothly if not for that bloody tree! This is all Nasti's fault!

steps.name: Gustave
steps.text: Smoothly? Even a junior assistant under Nasti saw through your tricks.

steps.name: Gustave
steps.text: The whole country would've seen your dirty laundry if he weren't every bit as naive as you, so much that he came to me for help.

steps.name: Gustave
steps.text: So tell me, how do you plan on dealing with it?

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: ...Please... help me... sir...

steps.name: Gustave
steps.text: Hmph. Whatever the reason Rhine had to build this floating unit, we can't let them continue to define their own creations.

steps.name: Gustave
steps.text: The administration should have had full authority over this, but it has been excluded from the assessment, thanks to your incompetence.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: You mean, we'll need a third party?

steps.name: Gustave
steps.text: A scientific consultant who is objective, professional, with the appearance of impartiality.

steps.name: Scientific Consultant
steps.text: Mr. Tannen. It's a pleasure.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: He doesn't look like a scientific consultant at all... can he really handle this Rhine stuff?

steps.name: Scientific Consultant
steps.text: I visited the floating platform in order to familiarize myself with the assessment subject.

steps.name: Scientific Consultant
steps.text: It's certainly an impressive 'tree'. And there was plenty of activity in its shade.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Over our cold, dead bodies!

steps.name: Tester
steps.text: (Mr. Jagger...)

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: (Just bluffing.)

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police
steps.text: Did radiation from beyond the Starpod fry your brain or something? You really want to bleed for this?

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police
steps.text: You'll get your wish, then!
Stop.

steps.name: Propeller Paradise Police
steps.text: That uniform... you're with Maylander?

steps.name: Council Member
steps.text: We are with the Maylander Foundation's Emergency Management Council. According to the bylaws of Propeller Paradise, the Council has the authority to take over all administrative and management functions in the event of an accident or disaster.

steps.name: Council Member
steps.text: You can check with Gordon Tannen and Gustave.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Emergency Management Council?

steps.name: Council Member
steps.text: Yes, Mr. Jagger.

steps.name: Council Member
steps.text: We understand your position, but we advise you to avoid any reckless actions. We are authorized to take extraordinary measures against you and your colleagues, if necessary.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: So Propeller Paradise is in a state of emergency, and your preliminary investigation has defined yesterday's event as a—'special incident'?

steps.name: Council Member
steps.text: Yes. The Council has established a special investigation team to obtain evidence from the scene and persons of interest.

steps.name: Council Member
steps.text: The investigation is ongoing. A hearing is the only fair and just course of action, in the absence of an official judicial institution. We thank you for your patience.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Does Rhine keep possession of this 'floating botanical unit' until the hearing?

steps.name: Council Member
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: I hope your investigation is as fair and just as the conclusion you just reached.

steps.name: Council Member
steps.text: There is no need to worry.

steps.name: Council Member
steps.text: The safety of the temporary floating platform has been ensured. Bravo is resuming patrol.

steps.name: Tester
steps.text: Are we just gonna leave, Mr. Jagger?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Maylander's authority looks real, judging from the reaction of the guards.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: The hearing keeps getting delayed, and things are still in flux. We won't learn anything if we stay here. Besides...

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Have any of you seen Director Lunorey?
